authority_separation.MR6D_primary_release: Provides nominal object mesh, BOP-style instance poses/camera/depth/masks. No official MR6D camera-dynamic native8 semantic labels identified in reviewed release metadata/docs.
authority_separation.task_native8: Eight camera-dynamic cuboid roles are the existing task/trained-channel contract. MR projections are derived reference preparation using that contract, not native8 gold supplied by MR authors.
authority_separation.historical_writer_provenance: Local original C#/Blender historical writer was not recovered in the existing audit. V74 reports exact empirical normal-facing reconstruction for 60000 stored synthetic records; this run verifies bound code and nominal CAD, not those 60000 bodies.
authority_separation.no_order_optimization: No new permutation optimized against queries, old roles, predictions, or real pixels. Stored dynamic arrays remain in place.

exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.axis_scope: X=800 and Y=1200 are fixed nominal model spans, not invariant camera-dynamic front width/depth. Source +Z is anatomical deck side; camera coordinates use OpenCV +Z forward.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.projection: X_camera = R_m2c X_model + t_m2c; homogeneous image = K X_camera, then divide by camera Z. Row-vector code implements points @ R.T + t.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.camera_object: solve(R, -t), used in V153; exact linear inverse avoids silently treating rounded R as perfectly orthonormal.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.front_choice: Maximum outward-normal cosine to camera from cuboid center, among four vertical faces only; top/bottom excluded.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.top_bottom: V74 uses source world Z; V153 MR adaptation passes centered model coordinates, retaining model +Z deck anatomy for upright source objects. This is an explicit adaptation, not a recovered official MR native8 rule.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.front_left_right: Front top endpoints sorted by projected image X; slots0/1 are left/right top and slots3/2 their vertical bottom partners.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.rear: Slots4..7 continue front0..3 through opposite depth edges; rear is not independently image-X sorted. A rear point can lie on a visible adjacent side/top; rear name does not force S.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.permutation_direction: dynamic[k] = fixed[perm[k]]; never reapply to already dynamic stored arrays.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.ties: np.argmax/face list order in replay helper. Exact historical writer tie policy uncertified. Face-score and top-LR margins are evidence flags, not automatic semantic thresholds.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.centroid: Separate projection of model center (0,0,0); index8 is outside native8 and is not the mean of eight 2D projections.
exact_coordinate_and_order_contract.training_visibility_flag_caveat: prepare_yolo_pose.py writes v=2 for known in-padded-canvas coordinates; this transport flag is not native semantic D.

per_native_conclusion: All native0..7 are dynamic roles over nominal AABB corners. In this Euro CAD all possible corresponding fixed corners are material vertices. Real-image physical corner/part/visibility identity remains uncertified for every role until target-instance, expected-part and alignment proof exists.

source_fixed_row_metadata.target_material_scope: MR6D obj1 wooden Euro pallet, nominal 800x1200x144mm; no selected SQUARE or other pallet material/design.

pose_and_dimension_uncertainty.scope: Static validation annotations use tracked camera and manually refined initial object poses. The manually designed Euro mesh is nominal; real pallets vary dimensionally.
pose_and_dimension_uncertainty.consequence: Do not invent +/-20mm or a pixel bound, fit a correction, or certify exact q support from nominal projection alone. CAD membership and valid rotation matrices do not remove this uncertainty.
pose_and_dimension_uncertainty.source_calibration_quality_vs_bound: The paper describes a process and expected accuracy; this is not a measured guarantee for each selected point/frame.

masks_and_depth.BOP_identity: IMID_GTID uses scene_gt list index, not object class ID.
masks_and_depth.BOP_mask_scope: full mask is object silhouette; visible mask is per-instance visible-surface silhouette proxy.
masks_and_depth.nonexclusive: Existing independently checked source frame5/frame9 visible masks overlap19371/16152 pixels; most overlap has positive measured depth. No unique cause inferred.
masks_and_depth.BOP19_formula: (d_model - d_test <= delta OR d_test == 0) AND d_model > 0; this is not an exclusive instance-owner rule.
masks_and_depth.MR_generation_uncertainty: Actual release mask visibility mode/delta not certified. Do not import the toolkit generic delta as MR ground truth.
masks_and_depth.negative_mask: Can reflect virtual/mesh gap, nominal pose/dimension drift, border, OOF or missing evidence; not automatically native external E.
masks_and_depth.positive_mask: Some target surface at the ray does not prove the expected rear/native point is visible.

required_native_part_proof.missing_proof: Original historical writer code/tie behavior is not recovered; no nearest-q or fitted permutation is permitted.

required_native_part_proof.required: Review the expected deck-board or bottom-runner neighborhood around the nominal reference, distinguishing self boundary, hole/gap, same-material other instance, and external object.
required_native_part_proof.missing_proof: Exact CAD membership is neither real material correspondence nor a universal prerequisite for virtual-native part review.

required_native_part_proof.required: Keep nominal CAD/pose projection and actual expected part separate; retain UNKNOWN when dimensional variation or projection alignment makes correspondence ambiguous.
required_native_part_proof.missing_proof: Release supplies no per-frame native coordinate covariance or hard <=3px bound.

required_native_part_proof.required: Assess expected native part in context and preserve self/external/unknown distinctions independently of literal q-center owner and pose/mask proxies.
required_native_part_proof.missing_proof: Target surface at a projected ray does not identify a rear native reference; foreign at q is not proof of native external E.

required_native_part_proof.required: Keep full-mask, visible-mask, measured valid depth, registration and overlap flags separately with original mask-generation uncertainty.
required_native_part_proof.missing_proof: Per-instance masks are nonexclusive; MR-specific visibility mode/delta and a unique overlap cause are not certified.
